quarterly_data.quarter: Victory Giant Technology IR activity record: 2026-09-19 (09-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, site visit 09-18): Plant Four completed whole-building equipment installation in Q1 and ramped in H1, with H2 capacity release paced to customer ramps; Plant Ten has started phase-one equipment move-in and debugging with the rest installed and trial production in H2; Plant Eleven is still in civil construction; the company recently won the adjacent OCT (Huizhou) industrial park land, where it plans mSAP, HDI and other high-end PCB capacity.

quarterly_data.quarter: Victory Giant Technology IR activity record: 2026-09-19 (09-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): main customers currently prefer domestic production, so the company prioritises mainland China capacity; in Thailand, A1 building phase-one utilisation is good, A1 phase-two high-end capacity has passed several customers' factory audits and started producing AI product verification boards with some part numbers validated, and the A2 building topped out in Q2.

quarterly_data.quarter: Victory Giant Technology IR activity record: 2026-09-19 (09-19-2026)
